scoringCalibration: One hair point is earned because the scalp coverage now fades over 13.5 mm at every open boundary, removing the hard helmet edge without changing collision-approved geometry. The primary groom still lacks convincing large and medium clumps.
visualFindings: The opaque forehead boundary now blends into the baby-hair layer instead of reading as a solid cap edge.
The temple and rear scalp transition is softer while the v33 undercut remains visible underneath.
All 40 v33 mesh objects retain identical vertex positions and polygon topology; only the scalp density attribute and material changed.
The crown remains too uniform and the thin guide strands still lack the grouped large-to-medium clump structure used by current game characters.
rejectedExperiments: v34 was rejected because 251 wide cards added saw-toothed ribbons around the ears and rear silhouette.
blockingFailures: The primary groom still needs hand-shaped large and medium clumps, a readable part, crown breakup and controlled side volume.
A true mouth slit, oral cavity, teeth, tongue and expression-compatible lip topology are still missing.
Integrated eyelid thickness and high-resolution canthus anatomy remain below review quality.
Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the standard pose suite remains incomplete.
Signed clothing-distance samples remain negative despite zero exact triangle overlaps in the two audited frames.
LOD transition popping and frame-time impact remain untested in the website renderer.
